source.license_review_notes: Paraphrased claims and citation links only; no copied upstream text, code, or weights are stored in either intake. License posture for the DreamCoder ec repository must be re-verified before any code-reference content_mode.

evidence_summary.notes: Two-source convergence intake (DreamCoder maintenance-side + DreamerV3 codebook construction-side) on rule-distinguishability. Primary sources are peer-reviewed/archival; intake is partial pending equation-level extraction of the DreamCoder refactoring algorithm and the DreamerV3 codebook-capacity tradeoff. Candidate claims are registered as candidate/substrate_conditional and promote nothing on their own.

falsification.claim_under_test: Rule distinguishability at REE's CandidateRuleField locus should be achieved and maintained by a principled mechanism -- a maintenance-side consolidation operator (MECH-437, DreamCoder analog) and/or a construction-side separable-key codebook (MECH-438, DreamerV3 analog) -- rather than by the current reactive affine conflict-gate theta(n_matched).
could_be_wrong_if: A periodic MDL-driven consolidation pass over the minted-rule pool yields no improvement in crf_frac_active / committed-class entropy vs a no-consolidation baseline on a substrate where more than 5 rules co-match (the lockout regime) -- falsifies MECH-437.

Quantising context keys onto a categorical codebook does not reduce mean n_matched below the lockout threshold, or reduces it only by collapsing distinct rules onto one key (drop in committed-class entropy / route diversity) -- falsifies MECH-438.
The CRF lockout turns out to be driven by minting too many rules or by the gate functional form itself, in which case neither distinguishability mechanism is the right fix.
falsification.notes: Falsifiers are pre-registered per candidate claim; V3-EXQ-654 lineage (crf_frac_active, committed-class entropy) supplies the metric instrumentation a future experiment would reuse.

governance_controls.conflict_review_notes: Convergence-side conflict scan complete: the candidate claims are registered as candidate/substrate_conditional/V4-leaning, wired into depends_on of the arc_062 cluster, and block no V3 closure node. They do not move any existing claim status or conflict ratio. REE_assembly governance adjudication still required before any decide-to-build.
rollback_conditions: Any net increase in unresolved claim conflicts in the arc_062 rule-apprehension cluster after registration.
Either candidate claim being mistakenly placed on the V3 critical path (owner_exq / blocker of a V3 closure node).

benchmark_acceptance_criteria.notes: Registering the candidate claims must not increase unresolved conflict pressure in MECH-309 / ARC-062 / ARC-063.
The V4-leaning candidates must keep the V3 closure percentage clean (no V3 plan node blocked on them).

implementation_readiness.notes: Decide-whether-to-build is a later governance step. If built, MECH-438 (construction-side) would amend candidate_rule_field.py context-key assignment; MECH-437 (maintenance-side) would add a consolidation operator reusing the ARC-063 sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry.

deltas.title: Maintenance-side distinguishability operator over the CRF pool (MECH-437, DreamCoder analog)
deltas.proposal: Register a candidate REE claim that rule-pool distinguishability is a maintained property requiring a periodic non-gradient consolidation/refactor operator (compress / merge near-duplicates / retire dead rules) under an MDL-style separability objective, rather than a side effect of minting or a reactive gate.
deltas.rationale: DreamCoder's abstraction-sleep refactoring is the working external instance of this operator; REE's CRF locus has only point-fix maintenance (theta-coupling, conflict-cap, context-match sharpening) and hits the GAP-B lockout.

deltas.title: Construction-side separable-key codebook for minted rules (MECH-438, DreamerV3 analog)
deltas.proposal: Register a candidate REE claim that minted-rule context keys should be assigned in a quantised / categorical codebook separable by construction, bounding the number of rules that co-match any context (n_matched) so theta(n_matched) stays below the availability ceiling -- without collapsing distinct rules onto a shared key.
deltas.rationale: DreamerV3's categorical discrete latents keep world-state keys separable by construction (32 categoricals x 32 classes, straight-through); the analog bounds the CRF co-match count up front rather than gating it reactively.

decisions.notes: Recommended outcome hybridize: the two mechanisms are complementary (construction bounds steady-state co-match; maintenance cleans residue). Final outcome and any decide-to-build set during REE_assembly governance adjudication; the candidate claims are already registered (candidate/substrate_conditional/V4-leaning).
